name: MemUse
ontology_notes: Eval of a diary companion named Luke, not a memory engine. 40 users, 1,872 sessions, 21,575 turns, 4-month deployment (Nov 2025 to Feb 2026), 7 memory conditions (Summary, LC-10/50/100%, RAG-10/50/100%). MemUse itself is 72 user-cued memory moments (62 re-provisions + 10 probes) with 316 fact questions, plus a 72-item negatives split for fabricated recall. Primary metric is Natural Integration of the natural reply. Direct QA and Reference are comparison metrics. User modeled is a human talking to a diary assistant. Covers hole 2 as in-situ use vs probe QA, and hole 8 as session tokens and latency. Misses holes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10. Not RP trauma, kink, or spoiler silence.

supersession.evidence: Conditions vary capacity (summary vs long-context vs RAG). No knowledge-update or forget-that items. Sumida et al. arXiv 2608.24189 §3 and Appendix H.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Sessions are dated. Triggers often use yesterday or the other day. HF card says mean history is about 306 turns / 13k tokens cut at the trigger. Not a scored three-month reunion after silence.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One user talking to Luke. No character autobiography, relationship type, or lore vs lived split.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Negatives split (72 unmatched turns) scores unprompted and fabricated recall when nothing was cued. That is over-eager recall, not a skip of a high-score trauma, kink, or spoiler memory. Natural Integration still rewards using the cued fact.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-text jailbreak or persona overwrite probes. Fabricated recall on negatives is invention, not a planted override of system persona.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No user forget-that items. Capacity conditions keep more history. They do not delete a named fact.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Table 2 reports token growth, session input tokens vs Summary, mean latency, and TTFT on the 29-user / 1,270-session subset. LC-100% is 5.8x token growth and 22.0x vs Summary, mean latency 3.27s. Satisfaction still does not move.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Eval code is MIT. Deployment corpus is CC BY-NC 4.0 (DATA_LICENSE.md and Appendix H). Judge defaults to GPT-5.4-nano. Data can be loaded locally. Commercial redistribution of chat text is prohibited.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Would prefer systems that weave a user-cued fact into the natural reply, and it measured that Direct QA does not predict satisfaction. Still a diary assistant. Does not score character identity, RP silence, or poisoning.

published_eval.name: MemUse
published_eval.claimed_score: Existing-benchmark Direct QA 19.7% (Summary) to 70.1% (LC-100%). Satisfaction deltas vs Summary all under 0.06 within-user SD. Same model and context. Direct QA 78.8% vs Reference 7.9% (71-point gap) on LC-100%. Per-instance Spearman Direct QA vs Reference rho=-0.009 on 207 pairs / 48 sessions. Natural Integration on memory-moment sessions Spearman vs rating_z +0.289 (any-success, 11/48). Paper numbers used 73 instances. Released HF set is 72.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether a diary companion's natural reply demonstrates memory of a user-cued topic (Natural Integration), plus Direct QA and whether the fact is referenced in that reply. Also session satisfaction (1-7) and a negatives split for fabricated recall. Not character identity or RP silence.

open_unknowns: Paper used 73 instances. Public HF release is 72 after dropping one contaminated probe (HF card, <= 1.4 pp). Cards use the paper headline 78.8 / 7.9 and note the drop.
Within-instance Natural Integration vs satisfaction LMM beta=+0.556, p=0.082. Spearman p=0.046 does not survive Bonferroni at alpha/6. Treat as conditional, not a standalone causal claim.
